stories.title: Gwysaney Estate submits plans for lodge park on land next to Theatr Clwyd
stories.summary: Plans for a holiday park of up to 70 lodges on farmland between Mold and Sychdyn have been submitted to Flintshire County Council. stories.title: North Wales Police officers describe work of online child abuse investigation team
stories.summary: A specialist North Wales Police team safeguarded 167 children last year through investigations into online child sexual abuse across the force area, which includes Flintshire. stories.title: Flintshire glamping farm seeks permission for two-storey pods
stories.summary: A glamping retreat in rural Flintshire has applied to turn two of its single-storey pods into two-storey getaway homes. stories.title: Farmers urged to stay alert as Bluetongue cases continue to rise
stories.summary: Farmers and livestock keepers across Wales are being urged to remain vigilant as cases of Bluetongue continue to rise on both sides of the border. The Welsh Government has renewed its call for farmers to check for signs of the disease and consider vaccinating their animals as more cases of the BTV-3 strain are confirmed
